name: agent-office
description: A 3D office in your browser for Claude Code. /agent-office:setup reads your project and gives every area its own agent and room. Agents show tool calls, Docker containers and terminal logs live; errors make them panic, stopped containers send them to the lounge. Walk around in boss mode and read their monitors. Optional premium office: /agent-office:premium builds a full walk-in building from your own Synty POLYGON Office pack.
